text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Mejiro
Dober, we notice a big
commotion in front of the
shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that... Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's such an honor to shake your hand!
Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I watched your last race from the front
row! You
really live up to your name as
the Empress!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It's so encouraging to have
your
support. I'll do my best to continue
meeting your
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're amazing! May I shake your
hand too?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Air Groove. That was an impressive
number of
fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm just grateful for their recognition. It
motivates
me to keep reaching for
greater heights in order
to repay all their
support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You really are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I would never be able to act that
confidently in
front of fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can't blame yourself for that.
Besides, I too
understand how
nerve-racking it is to be in front
of a
crowd.
choice_data_list: そう卑下することはないよ
choice_data_list_en: There's no need to put yourself down like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But you mustn't lose yourself. The most
important
thing is what you want to do,
and nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What I want to do?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Mejiro Dober! You're just as
wonderful in
person!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I've heard so much about you recently!
You've
turned me into a real fan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are they talking about me?! And
not Air
Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sh-shut up! You're seriously messing with
my
head!
choice_data_list: 君も魅力的なウマ娘だからね
貴方も魅力的なウマ娘だからね
choice_data_list_en: You're a charming Umamusume too, after all.
You're a charming Umamusume yourself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, not you too, Trainer! I-I don't have
any idea
what's going on anymore...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to have your hard work

recognized and receive their support,
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to have your hard work

recognized and receive their support,
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... It makes me happy, and I do want
to thank
them for their encouragement...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not like you, Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not like you, Air Groove...
choice_data_list: 君が今できる感謝を伝えればいい
貴方が今できる感謝を伝えればいい
俺は全力で応援するよ！
私は全力で応援するよ！
choice_data_list_en: Just express whatever gratitude you can right now.
Just show the gratitude you can right now
I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!
I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: 君が今できる感謝を伝えればいい
貴方が今できる感謝を伝えればいい
俺は全力で応援するよ！
私は全力で応援するよ！
choice_data_list_en: Just express whatever gratitude you can right now.
Just show the gratitude you can right now
I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!
I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. All they want from you are some
sincere
words.
choice_data_list: いきなり完璧を目指さなくていい
choice_data_list_en: You don't have to aim for perfection right off the bat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a
time, you'll
move closer to not only me...
but also the racer
you want to become.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll do it. I'll do my best to better myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: U-um! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're the last person I need support
from...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your support, but...
choice_data_list: また1歩、前に進んでみよう
お父さんに胸を張れるようになるんでしょ
choice_data_list_en: You want to make your dad proud, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Another step...
choice_data_list: また1歩、前に進んでみよう
お父さんに胸を張れるようになるんでしょ
choice_data_list_en: You want to make your dad proud, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I was going to even without you
bossing
me around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right. This is my chance to
grow. I
don't want to have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a
time, you'll
move closer to not only me...
but also the racer
you want to become.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: U-um! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I still have a long way to go compared to
other
racers...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to do my best! And, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your support! It means
so much
to me!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you too! We're cheering for
you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You didn't even have anything to
worry
about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...If you say so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-was it? ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm changing slowly but surely... I just
know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her icy response to my
encouragement,
Mejiro Dober can't
completely hide how pleased
she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she thanks me, Mejiro Dober's
expression
brightens like a ray of light
peeking out from the
clouds.
